U1_DECISION.scope: U1 only; no U2-U6 design changes, application changes, PostgreSQL connection, migration or provider execution
U1_DECISION.conclusion: No responsibility-preserving owner exists in the currently fixed identity/responsibility manifest for all D09 receipts. Exact count alone is not a general impossibility theorem: count plus all 27 fixed responsibilities, no embedded generic history and no additional persistence is the conflicting constraint set.

options.reason: A natural Recipe version, Payment attempt, receipt document or actual Agent run can retain its own genuine creation result. Ingredient rename, rejected create and arbitrary rejected siblings are none of these domain rows. User/Category/Supplier/composition rows are also identities/composition, not arbitrary operations.

Distributing fixed receipt slots across aggregate roots is finite and loses N+1. Variable history collections would be prohibited entity journal storage. Missing-target creation has no child root; assigning every failure to actor User or an unrelated Supplier/Product broadens responsibility. Splitting child receipts still needs one immutable multi-resource root result and authoritative cross-owner uniqueness.

All 27 identities already have mandatory domain responsibilities; no reserved CommandReceipt identity. Four transitional source models are not spare target identities. Renaming/replacing an identity or combining two responsibilities requires explicit architecture change; none is silently selected.
Under fixed responsibilities, exhaustive owner classes below cannot host required non-domain command rows. A new receipt responsibility or approved reallocation is necessary; D09 is not weakened.

owner_exhaustion.failure: Principal/classification/menu/ingredient/counterparty/configuration rows; neither K1/K2 rename events nor missing-target rejected commands are new instances. Per-entity journal prohibited.
Physical origin/event/count evidence; rename/rejected create does not create stock/count evidence. Synthetic events or counts forbidden.
Menu version/composition; arbitrary manual mutation/rejection is no menu component/version.
Actual sale/line/selection; failed creation has no sale, Ingredient rename has none either.
Quote/procurement/ordered-line/receiving evidence; arbitrary rename and no-target failure are none of these.
Real customer attempt/provider event/account-date reconciliation; arbitrary command failure is no charge, callback or statement.
Genuine Agent run/actual dispatch/evaluation only; manual rename or rejected manual creation cannot fabricate Agent activity.

U1_DECISION.evidence_boundary: Argument over binding responsibilities and current source, not PostgreSQL persistence evidence. All witness proofs below are conditional on architecture approval of a legitimate receipt owner; current constrained architecture fails them.

WHY_THIS_OWNER_IS_LEGITIMATE: Only after explicit architecture approval: a CommandReceipt row means one authorized command's immutable terminal outcome, independent of whether domain creation succeeded. Rejection is a genuine command outcome, not a fake domain object/event. Domain tables retain their existing responsibilities. This proposed owner is additional business persistence and must be counted honestly; it cannot be called infrastructure to evade count.

fields.id: TEXT primary key, server-generated collision-resistant identity
fields.scope: TEXT NOT NULL, server-defined namespace with authorization rules; preserve existing key semantics until explicit protocol migration
fields.commandKind: TEXT NOT NULL, stable semantic operation identifier
fields.callerKey: TEXT NOT NULL, original Idempotency-Key; never regenerate on retry
fields.actorId: TEXT NOT NULL FK User(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT for current authenticated workflow commands
fields.commandVersion: INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK > 0; handler/semantic contract version, included in request hash; changing version does not create a new key identity
fields.canonicalVersion: INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK > 0; canonical byte encoding version
fields.requestHash: CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK lowercase SHA-256 hex; actor/scope/kind/commandVersion/canonicalVersion/expectedVersions/payload bound
fields.expectedVersions: JSONB NOT NULL canonical exact decimal string map; validation context, never sole authoritative FK store
fields.outcome: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK IN ('SUCCEEDED','REJECTED'); no new ENUM
fields.httpStatus: SMALLINT NOT NULL with outcome/command-specific status checks
fields.resultVersion: INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK > 0; immutable response contract version
fields.responseBodyBytes: BYTEA NOT NULL; exact final application response bytes including existing HTTP success/error envelope; not a reconstructed current entity or reserialized JSON object
fields.responseContentType: TEXT NOT NULL; immutable application representation metadata
fields.responseHeaders: Immutable allowlisted application headers only; exclude transport Date/connection/request trace headers, credentials and cookies
fields.createdAt: TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL; command acceptance timestamp
fields.outcomeRecordedAt: TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL; terminal record preparation time, durable only when transaction commits; not true COMMIT wall-clock time
fields.committedAt: NOT FROZEN: true commit timestamp cannot be populated in same transaction by pretending now()/clock_timestamp() is future commit time. If logical commit-associated timestamp is sufficient, explicitly define it as outcomeRecordedAt; otherwise approve separately specified durable commit-time capture before schema freeze. Do not claim current mock committedAt meets true commit-time requirement.
fields.parentReceiptId: Nullable self-FK ON DELETE RESTRICT for explicitly linked Agent/business subcommand; must not fabricate a second root outcome or defer cross-store atomicity
fields.typedRootLinks: Nullable root columns FK Ingredient, Product, Recipe, Order, PurchaseRequest, second PurchaseRequest for credit transfer, GoodsReceipt, StockCount, Payment, PaymentReconciliation and AgentExecution as command-specific shapes require. Link only real existing or atomically created roots. No required target FK on rejected creation; actor/receipt identity still valid. No invented approval/memory table or generic type/id pseudo-FK.

COMMAND_RECEIPT_SCHEMA.uniqueness: UNIQUE(scope,commandKind,callerKey). Hash and version excluded from unique key so changed content/version cannot escape key conflict. Store tuple, not only r6 digest. Agent actor namespace maps explicitly; never merge current Agent and business key spaces silently.
COMMAND_RECEIPT_SCHEMA.immutability: Insert one terminal row; no committed PENDING placeholder required. UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE forbidden through runtime privileges/guards. No ON CONFLICT overwrite. Future erasure policy must preserve required replay semantics; no silent TTL, response truncation, hash-only retention or slot limit.
COMMAND_RECEIPT_SCHEMA.foreign_keys: Actor/root FKs retained RESTRICT. Missing requested target ID may exist as inert request metadata and must not be assigned a false FK. Required-success root shapes enforced by command dictionary; rejected paths allow absent roots. Multi-item effects reference real Order/PR/Receipt root through existing typed domain relationships, not response JSON as authority.
COMMAND_RECEIPT_SCHEMA.timestamps_note: Prior mock committedAt is captured before work/commit. Renaming its meaning or adding true commit-time audit is a contract decision, not fabricated evidence. PostgreSQL date/time semantics: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/functions-datetime.html
COMMAND_RECEIPT_SCHEMA.legacy_public_auth_note: Public registration/password-reset and service-only writes cannot fabricate a User actor. They need an explicitly reviewed principal/scope variant before joining same receipt schema; current minimum workflow commands all require authenticated User. No credential-bearing response is automatically retained.

COMMAND_TO_OWNER_MATRIX.profile_resolution: Each row supplies all 12 requested dimensions. Shared protocol names refer to sections in this artifact. Candidate domain owner is effect owner only, not accepted receipt owner. Null legitimate_physical_owner is intentional.

common_profiles.business_key: Current caller c.key / HTTP Idempotency-Key. Immutable across retry; UNIQUE(scope,kind,key) proposed after owner approval; actor and expected versions bound by hash.
common_profiles.business_hash: Current operationIdentity: r6 key hashes {type,scope,callerKey}; requestHash hashes {actorId,versions,payload}. Proposed versioned envelope adds explicit command/canonical versions; do not silently reinterpret existing keys/hashes.
common_profiles.agent_key: Current Agent identity JSON.stringify([actorId,kind,key]); proposed scope explicitly contains actor namespace and maps to full tuple uniqueness.
common_profiles.agent_hash: Current SHA-256 canonical {actorId,kind,payload}; proposal hash/source versions remain distinct business guards. Versioned receipt envelope required before persistent adapter.
common_profiles.retention: All required terminal outcomes append without overwrite/fixed cap/cache TTL; retain business-history lifetime, until an explicitly approved D09-compatible erasure/retention policy. Current permission checked before disclosure.
common_profiles.current_business_storage: MockRepository process-local operations map; no PostgreSQL physical owner
common_profiles.current_agent_storage: AgentState process-local operations map; no PostgreSQL physical owner
common_profiles.proposed_storage: Unapproved CommandReceipt immutable terminal row, success or rejection; exact final HTTP envelope bytes frozen once
common_profiles.replay: REPLAY_PROTOCOL, never execute effects if exact tuple/hash found
common_profiles.unknown: UNKNOWN_COMMIT_PROTOCOL, no blind retry or negative lookup from replica

REJECTION_STORAGE.current: No valid physical location in fixed 27-table responsibilities. Mock maps lose receipt on process restart.
REJECTION_STORAGE.proposed_after_approval: Standalone CommandReceipt row; target links nullable. Outer transaction locks current actor and command key before SAVEPOINT effects. Recognized business rejection -> ROLLBACK TO effects -> insert rejection receipt outside rolled-back effects -> COMMIT outer transaction. Receipt insert failure rolls back whole transaction; no response reported as durable.
REJECTION_STORAGE.retained: Authorized canonicalizable deterministic business invalidity, not-found, stale-version, unavailable stock, invalid lifecycle, invalid/stale/expired approval and equivalent declared domain failures. Input/expected versions frozen before execution. Never revalidate an already retained rejection against new mutable state on replay.
REJECTION_STORAGE.not_new_terminal_receipts: Unauthenticated/current-unauthorized access, malformed transport without usable command identity, hash conflict against existing key, infrastructure/serialization/deadlock/connection failure; these must not overwrite an existing receipt. Current authorization denial before replay intentionally hides prior response.
REJECTION_STORAGE.validation_gap: HTTP zod parsing currently occurs before BusinessWorkflows/Agent command receipt boundary, so canonicalizable business validation rejected there is not retained. A future adapter must move deterministic domain validation under receipt handling and freeze final HTTP envelope. Malformed transport is distinct from authorized business rejection; no D09 weakening by relabeling domain failures as transport.
REJECTION_STORAGE.savepoint_limit: Locks acquired after savepoint may be released on rollback; receipt key/authority locks must precede savepoint. Infrastructure/deferred constraint failure at COMMIT is whole-transaction failure; known business constraints requiring retained rejection must be evaluated/mapped within effect savepoint.

REPLAY_PROTOCOL: Authenticate; load and lock current User authority; verify endpoint/object access. Normalize server-owned scope/kind; validate canonicalizable command envelope without running domain mutations.

Acquire transaction-scoped command-key advisory lock before effect savepoint. Then query immutable receipt by full tuple on authoritative primary. Full-tuple unique constraint remains authority; advisory digest collisions only serialize unrelated commands.

Existing row: confirm actor access and original versioned request hash. Match returns original status/body bytes and immutable application headers; mismatch returns 409 without replacing old row. Do not reconstruct response from latest Ingredient/Order/Payment/Agent state.

Absent row: execute once under effect savepoint; retain exact success or recognized rejection; commit effects plus terminal receipt atomically. No provider/LLM/email network side effect inside receipt SQL transaction.

After restart use same tuple/versioned canonicalizer and bytes. Current privilege revocation can deny replay; exact historical response is returned only when currently authorized. Domain state changes cannot erase or rewrite historical responses.

UNKNOWN_COMMIT_PROTOCOL.current: BusinessWorkflows on UNKNOWN performs authorized operation lookup; matching receipt returns result, absent receipt rethrows UNKNOWN. In-memory lookup is not durable proof.
conditional_steps: Retain original tuple/hash/body/versions. A connection error or lost COMMIT reply means UNKNOWN, not rollback. Do not submit a new key.

Recover on authoritative writable primary for same durable database incarnation; authenticate/current-authorize and acquire same transaction command-key lock. If original transaction unresolved, lock waits or times out to UNKNOWN.

After lock acquisition execute a fresh READ COMMITTED receipt SELECT. Matching tuple/hash -> original committed result; mismatch -> conflict. Another writer must not bypass key lock or atomic receipt/effects rule.

Absence means confirmed local rollback only if original key holder has resolved, no prepared transaction remains, database lineage/durability is intact, receipt retention is intact and every effect writer atomically wrote receipt. Otherwise absence remains UNKNOWN. Stale snapshot/replica/promotion that lost acknowledged writes cannot prove rollback.

Only confirmed rollback permits bounded retry of same command, at most three total confirmed attempts. While authority unavailable/unresolved, return pending/UNKNOWN; no claimed authoritative answer. External provider outcome requires provider lookup separately, never inferred from local absence.
UNKNOWN_COMMIT_PROTOCOL.durability_boundary: Process restart on same durable primary is recoverable under proposed protocol. All-node loss or asynchronous failover data loss cannot be made exactly-once by a receipt table. Deployment durability/fencing assumptions must be explicit before evidence is claimed.

K1_K2_REPLAY_PROOF.current_27_result: FAIL: current mutable Ingredient plus finite columns cannot reconstruct retained exact K1 result after K2; no lawful event/journal owner is available.
conditional_after_owner_approval: Initial Ingredient I.name=A, version=1. K1=(scope,ingredient.edit,key1), requestHash H1 binds I/A->B/expected v1/actor. Atomic success stores I=B/v2 and immutable receipt R1 containing exact original application HTTP status/body bytes B/v2.
K2 uses key2 and expected v2. Atomic success stores I=C/v3 and separate receipt R2 with C/v3. Unique identities differ by key; R1 cannot be overwritten.
Restart. Authorized replay key1 with original payload/expected v1 finds R1 before current-version business validation, verifies H1, returns R1 bytes B/v2. No effect function runs; I remains C/v3.

Changed key1 payload/hash -> 409; R1 and I unchanged. For arbitrary distinct Ki, each has independent append row, so no N-slot limit. Proof rests on terminal immutability, full-tuple uniqueness, shared transaction and durable retention, not hash alone.
